name: Thabo Moloi
bio:
Thabo Moloi's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Cape Town, he initially worked in the financial sector. However, a chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion that led him to pursue opportunities within the motorsport industry. He started with smaller racing teams, honing his skills in managing complex IT infrastructure under pressure.

Thabo's approach to IT systems management is rooted in proactive problem-solving and meticulous planning. He believes in staying ahead of potential issues by implementing robust monitoring systems and regularly updating security protocols. His dedication to ensuring seamless data flow and communication across all departments is what makes him a valuable asset. Thabo's distinctive trait is his ability to translate complex technical jargon into easily understandable terms for non-technical team members, fostering better collaboration and understanding.

Now with Hendrick Motorsports, Thabo is excited to bring his years of experience to one of the most successful teams in NASCAR. He looks forward to the challenges of keeping the team at the forefront of technological advancement while also ensuring the reliability and security of the team's IT infrastructure.

physical.description: Thabo is of average height with a wiry build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always keeps a small Rubik's Cube on his desk and solves it during stressful moments.
Insists on backing up all data at 3:03 PM every day, citing a South African folklore about the number three.
Has an extensive collection of vintage computer parts he displays in his office.
